sources.title: Qwen 3 — Alibaba's Most Powerful AI Model - Singularity Moments
sources.snippet: What Is Qwen 3? Qwen 3 is Alibaba's third-generation large language model family, released in 2026 as a significant leap over Qwen 2.5. The model family spans multiple parameter sizes — from efficient 7B variants to the full-scale flagship — and is made available under a permissive open-source licence, enabling commercial use worldwide.
